_meta.fill_ingredient: Every base nominates one ingredient as the fill ingredient. Its listed quantity is the starting amount; the macro engine then tops that ingredient up until the frozen base reaches the configured freezer fill volume (default 525ml). Base ingredients and blended flavour additions occupy that volume; mix-ins are added after spinning and do not displace the fill ingredient.
_meta.quantities: Quantities are per one 525ml frozen base, with listed mix-ins added afterwards.

bases.name: Everyday creamy
bases.summary: For vanilla, caramel, coffee and biscuit flavours.
bases.guidance: The default base. Blend the protein powder and xanthan gum together dry before adding liquid so the xanthan disperses without clumping.

bases.name: Fruit and yoghurt
bases.summary: More room for banana, mango, berries or cooked apple.
bases.guidance: Leaves headroom for 100–160g of fruit. Blend fruit completely smooth to avoid icy pockets. Xanthan is optional for banana but useful for berries.

bases.name: Chocolate creamy
bases.summary: The Everyday creamy base, using chocolate protein and cocoa.
bases.guidance: Cocoa quantity comes from the individual recipe. Dutch-process cocoa gives a rounder, darker flavour.

bases.name: Dessert-style
bases.summary: Quark and a little light cream cheese for a denser, more dessert-like finish.
bases.guidance: Use when the recipe specifies Dessert-style. Fat-free cottage cheese can replace quark gram for gram, but blend it completely smooth first.

bases.name: Cheesecake
bases.summary: The dessert-style base, tuned for tangy cheesecake flavours.
bases.guidance: For the cleanest cheesecake texture, quark is the first choice over cottage cheese. A squeeze of lemon juice sharpens the tang on any flavour in this base.

bases.name: Coconut
bases.summary: The fruit base with part of the milk replaced by light coconut milk.
bases.guidance: Light coconut milk tastes more convincing than coconut extract alone.
